Chooses the graphics driver for the next [Graphics](Graphics) call. This is the GPU that draws everything in the program, so it has to be called before the first [Graphics](Graphics), [LoadImage](LoadImage), [CreateTexture](CreateTexture) or any other command that makes an image or texture. The choice is kept when [EndGraphics](EndGraphics) closes the window.
@param driver  The driver number, starting at 1.
@gap Any number except 1 to [CountGfxDrivers](CountGfxDrivers) stops the program with an error message. Calling it once the GPU is in use stops a program compiled with -d with an error message, and is ignored in any other build. A driver that cannot draw to the window (or does not do Vulkan 1.3) stops the program at [Graphics](Graphics).
